moments.title: Queen of Pop turns 68
moments.blurb: Madonna, the iconic singer, songwriter, and actress, celebrates her 68th birthday on August 16th, continuing her reign as a global music phenomenon.

angles.name: Iconic Hits
angles.copy: Still got the moves like Madonna! Happy 68th to the Queen of Pop, who keeps reinventing and dominating. What's your ultimate Madonna anthem?

angles.name: 80s Rewind
angles.copy: From 'Like a Virgin' to global superstar. Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to the one and only Madonna! Pure 80s magic.

moments.title: Led Zeppelin legend Robert Plant at 78
moments.blurb: Robert Plant, the legendary frontman of Led Zeppelin and acclaimed solo artist, will celebrate his 78th birthday on August 20th.

angles.name: Rock God
angles.copy: Happy 78th birthday to the voice of a generation, Robert Plant! Still rocking harder than most. What's your favourite Zeppelin track?

angles.name: Led Zeppelin Legacy
angles.copy: From the Golden God to a timeless troubadour. Wishing Robert Plant a very happy 78th on August 20th! His influence is unmatched.

moments.title: Andrew Garfield turns 43
moments.blurb: Award-winning British-American actor Andrew Garfield, known for his roles in 'Spider-Man' and 'The Social Network', celebrates his 43rd birthday on August 20th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Actor
angles.copy: Happy 43rd birthday to the incredible Andrew Garfield! From superhero to Oscar-nominated drama, what's your favourite of his performances?

angles.name: Film Focus
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 43rd to Andrew Garfield on August 20th! A talent that shines on screen and stage.

moments.title: Kelis celebrates her 47th birthday
moments.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and chef Kelis, known for hits like 'Milkshake' and 'Caught Out There', will be celebrating her 47th birthday on August 21st.

angles.name: Milkshake Memories
angles.copy: Her milkshake brings all the hits to the yard! Happy 47th birthday to the fantastic Kelis on August 21st!

angles.name: Timeless Tracks
angles.copy: Celebrating Kelis's 47th on August 21st! Her unique sound defined an era and still gets us moving.

moments.title: Dua Lipa turns 31
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa, known for her chart-topping albums and singles, celebrates her 31st birthday on August 22nd.

angles.name: Pop Princess
angles.copy: Future Nostalgia and beyond! Wishing a very happy 31st birthday to the one and only Dua Lipa on August 22nd. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: She consistently delivers the hits! Happy 31st to Dua Lipa. Get ready to dance into her birthday weekend!

moments.title: Happy Mondays' Shaun Ryder is 64
moments.blurb: Shaun Ryder, the iconic frontman of Happy Mondays and Black Grape, celebrates his 64th birthday on August 23rd.

angles.name: Madchester Legend
angles.copy: Step On! Happy 64th birthday to the one and only Shaun Ryder on August 23rd. A true legend of the Madchester scene.

angles.name: 90s Icon
angles.copy: From Happy Mondays to Black Grape, Shaun Ryder's unique style defined an era. Wishing him a very happy 64th!

moments.title: Electronic pioneer Jean-Michel Jarre at 78
moments.blurb: French electronic music pioneer Jean-Michel Jarre, celebrated for his monumental outdoor concerts and ambient soundscapes, turns 78 on August 24th.

angles.name: Electronic Master
angles.copy: Happy 78th birthday to the visionary Jean-Michel Jarre on August 24th! His electronic soundscapes continue to inspire.

angles.name: Ambient Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Jean-Michel Jarre as he turns 78. A true pioneer of ambient and electronic music.

moments.title: Madness bassist Mark Bedford is 65
moments.blurb: Mark Bedford, the bassist and founding member of the iconic British ska band Madness, celebrates his 65th birthday on August 24th.

angles.name: Ska Legend
angles.copy: Our House! Wishing a very happy 65th birthday to Mark Bedford of Madness on August 24th. Cheers to the bassist behind those classic tracks!

angles.name: British Icons
angles.copy: Happy 65th to Mark Bedford! The man who laid down the basslines for some of the greatest British hits with Madness.
